name: label_map(match)
query:
sort(label_map((
			label_set(time(), "label", "v1"),
			label_set(time()+100, "label", "v2"),
			label_set(time()+200, "label", "v3"),
			label_set(time()+300, "x", "y"),
			label_set(time()+400, "label", "v4"),
		), "label", "v1", "foo", "v2", "bar", "", "qwe", "v4", ""))

name: label_join dst_label is equal to src_label
label_value()
query:
with (
			x = (
				label_set(time() > 1500, "foo", "123.456", "__name__", "aaa"),
				label_set(-time(), "foo", "bar", "__name__", "bbb"),
				label_set(-time(), "__name__", "bxs"),
				label_set(-time(), "foo", "45", "bar", "xs"),
			)
		)
		sort(x + label_value(x, "foo"))

name: sum(label_graphite_group)
query:
sort(sum by (__name__) (
			label_graphite_group((
				alias(1, "foo.bar.baz"),
				alias(2, "x.y.z"),
				alias(3, "qe.bar.qqq"),
			), 1)
		))

name: vector + vector on matching
query:
sort_desc(
			(label_set(time(), "t1", "v123", "t2", "v3") or label_set(10, "t2", "v2"))
			+ on (foo, t2)
			(label_set(100, "t1", "v1") or label_set(time(), "t2", "v3"))
		)

name: vector + vector on group_left matching
query:
sort_desc(
			(label_set(time(), "t1", "v123", "t2", "v3"), label_set(10, "t2", "v3", "xxx", "yy"))
			+ on (foo, t2) group_left (t1, noxxx)
			(label_set(100, "t1", "v1"), label_set(time(), "t2", "v3", "noxxx", "aa"))
		)

name: vector + vector on group_left(*)
query:
sort_desc(
			(label_set(time(), "t1", "v123", "t2", "v3"), label_set(10, "t2", "v3", "xxx", "yy"))
			+ on (foo, t2) group_left (*)
			(label_set(100, "t1", "v1"), label_set(time(), "t2", "v3", "noxxx", "aa"))
		)

name: vector + vector on group_left(*) prefix
query:
sort_desc(
			(label_set(time(), "t1", "v123", "t2", "v3"), label_set(10, "t2", "v3", "xxx", "yy"))
			+ on (foo, t2) group_left (*) prefix "abc_"
			(label_set(100, "t1", "v1"), label_set(time(), "t2", "v3", "noxxx", "aa"))
		)

name: vector + vector on group_left (__name__)
query:
sort_desc(
			(union(label_set(time(), "t2", "v3", "__name__", "vv3", "x", "y"), label_set(10, "t2", "v3", "__name__", "yy")))
			+ on (t2, dfdf) group_left (__name__, xxx)
			(label_set(100, "t1", "v1") or label_set(time(), "t2", "v3", "__name__", "abc"))
		)

name: vector + vector ignoring matching
query:
sort_desc(
			(label_set(time(), "t1", "v123", "t2", "v3") or label_set(10, "t2", "v2"))
			+ ignoring (foo, t1, bar)
			(label_set(100, "t1", "v1") or label_set(time(), "t2", "v3"))
		)

name: vector + vector ignoring group_right matching
query:
sort_desc(
			(label_set(time(), "t1", "v123", "t2", "v3") or label_set(10, "t2", "v321", "t1", "v123", "t32", "v32"))
			+ ignoring (foo, t2) group_right ()
			(label_set(100, "t1", "v123") or label_set(time(), "t1", "v123", "t2", "v3"))
		)

name: vector + vector fill()
query:
sort_by_label((
			label_set(1, "foo", "common")
			or label_set(2, "foo", "left_only")
		) + fill(0) (
			label_set(3, "foo", "common")
			or label_set(4, "foo", "right_only")
		), "foo")

			label_set(1, "foo", "common", "extra", "l")

name: vector + vector on() group_left() fill_right()
query:
sort_by_label((
			label_set(1, "method", "get", "code", "500")
			or label_set(2, "method", "get", "code", "404")
			or label_set(3, "method", "put", "code", "501")
		) + on(method) group_left() fill_right(0) (
			label_set(10, "method", "get")
		), "method", "code")

name: vector / vector ignoring() fill()
query:

			label_set(6, "method", "get", "code", "500")

			or label_set(5, "method", "post")
			or label_set(10, "method", "put")
		), "method")

name: sum(share() by (k))
query:

			label_set(time()/100+10, "k", "v1"),
			label_set(time()/200+5, "k", "v2", "a", "b"),
			label_set(time()/110-10, "k", "v1", "a", "b"),
			label_set(time()/90-5, "k", "v2"),
		)) by (k)), 0.001)
